data.gender_notes: Sarbesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sar meaning 'ruler' and bh meaning 'all' or 'everything'. This name signifies that the bearer is the one who rules over all. The name Sarbesh carries the meaning “Ruler of All” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sarbesh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sarbesh is a powerful name that resonates with the divine energy of the universe. It signifies the inner strength and wisdom of the individual and represents their ability to rule over their own destiny.
data.etymology: Sarbesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of All.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarbesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The soul is the true ruler, and this name is a reminder of the inner power and potential that resides within each one of us.
